name: Scroll Story
summary: Pinned scroll story: captions blur-swap on the left while a scrubbed element on the right (a toast living through every state) animates with the scroll.
useWhen: A product feature is best explained as one object changing step by step
A landing page needs a scroll-driven walkthrough with a pinned visual
avoidWhen: The page needs plain, quick-to-scan sections
Pinned scrolling would fight a nested scroll container
